album.title: Final Boss
album.eyebrow: Final Boss · an Electric Bat single for the dance floor
album.statement: One heavy dance track: the game's System AI against the boss, with a robot choir in the machine.

themes.handshake: Root, fifth, octave, minor third: the album's greeting, here the System AI's chime.

songs.title: Final Boss

takes.note: Mir: a duet between the System AI and the boss, the boss deeper and very aggressive, a robot choir in the background, a heavy dance track.
Mir: 160 BPM, same notes, add synthy lasers.

songs.concept: A boss fight sung as a duet. The System AI coaches the player (dodge, block, counter, stay on the beat); the boss taunts, rages, loses its armour, and at the end puts in a coin of its own. Continue?
